Question: Let \(c\) be a real number, and let \(z_1,\) \(z_2\) be the two complex numbers satisfying the quadratic \(z^2-cz+10=0.\) Points \(z_1,\) \(z_2,\) \(\dfrac{1}{z_1},\) and \(\dfrac{1}{z_2}\) are the vertices of a (convex) quadrilateral \(Q\) in the complex plane. When the area of \(Q\) obtains its maximum value, \(c\) is the closest to which of the following?
